key.name: has-saved-toggle-application-view
key.summary: Internal: whether saved-toggle-application-view holds a value to restore

key.name: pinned
key.summary: Pinned app ids, in display order

key.name: provider-prefix
key.summary: Character that starts a provider trigger such as /calc

key.name: track-usage
key.summary: Record launches for the Recent view and ranking

key.name: theme-primary
key.description: Accent fill for the selected row. Empty uses the built-in default (#fff59b). Accepts #rgb, #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa.

key.name: theme-on-primary
key.description: Text and glyphs on the primary fill. Empty uses the built-in default (#0e0e43). Accepts #rgb, #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa.

key.name: theme-surface
key.description: Panel background. Empty uses the built-in default (#070722). Accepts #rgb, #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa.

key.name: theme-surface-container
key.description: Card and toolbar background. Empty uses the built-in default (#11112d). Accepts #rgb, #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa.

key.name: theme-on-surface
key.description: Primary text. Empty uses the built-in default (#f3edf7). Accepts #rgb, #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa.

key.name: theme-on-surface-variant
key.description: Secondary text (subtitles, hints). Empty uses the built-in default (#7c80b4). Accepts #rgb, #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa.

key.name: theme-outline-variant
key.description: 1px card borders. Empty uses the built-in default (#21215f). Accepts #rgb, #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa.

key.name: theme-hover
key.description: Hovered row fill. Empty uses the built-in default (#9bfece). Accepts #rgb, #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa.

key.name: theme-on-hover
key.description: Text on the hovered row. Empty uses the built-in default (#0e0e43). Accepts #rgb, #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa.

key.name: theme-radius-scale
key.summary: Theme token: multiplier for all corner radii

key.name: theme-font-family
key.description: Empty uses the system interface font.

key.name: theme-overrides-locked
key.summary: Ask integrations not to change theme tokens
key.description: Advisory: integrations that write theme-* keys must check this first and leave the tokens alone when it is true. See docs/theming.md.
